### Quick start (Area Planner)
- Plan View → select the “Area” tab.
- Click “Activate Area Definition Mode”; click on the map to set center; drag/adjust.
- Set width/height, line spacing, points per line, altitude, loiter time.
- For multi‑drone: set drone count, altitude band start/step, time offset; toggle RTL/Loiter policies as needed.
- Click “Refresh Preview” (stats panel) to view per‑drone waypoint counts; optionally toggle visibility in legend.
- Generate aggregated mission: “Generate Mission and Add to Mission Tab”; then use normal Plan upload/save.
- Per‑drone missions: use “Insert Drone # to Mission”, “Insert All Drones”, “Save Per‑Drone Mission Files”, or map each drone to a vehicle and “Upload All Mapped”.

- Verification tips:
  - Check live overlays appear on map after setting center and dimensions.
  - Mission Items list should show takeoff, waypoint+loiter pairs, return and land after generation.
  - For per‑drone uploads, watch upload progress and mission contents on each vehicle.

- If needed, see the docs listed above for step‑by‑step screenshots and SITL guidance.
